name: ai4science-skills
description: Community index of Claude skills for scientific work. Every entry is pinned to an exact commit and checked automatically.

plugins.name: szl-evidence-skills
plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev as an optional, fail-closed second reader for evidence triage; decisions that carry their own evidence. Same source revision as the science pack.
hosted_services: api.typesafe.ai - szl-typesafe-ai only, optional; sends the state you pass it; requires your own TypeSafe key
docs.typesafe.ai - linked documentation; visiting fetches documentation, not benchmark input
console.typesafe.ai - linked credential console; user-controlled credential setup

plugins.name: szl-science-skills
plugins.description: Eighteen offline, stdlib-only science checks: project workbench and claim ledger, dataset leakage, model evaluation with complete denominators, math and kernel checks, paired qualification, reproducibility capsules, artifact lineage, unit invariants, negative controls, analysis-plan audit, evidence gate, cross-implementation check, mutation coverage, energy receipts, session receipts and a one-page reviewer pack.
hosted_services: huggingface.co - optional explicit fetch-triage downloads four pinned public synthetic-study files and records byte hashes; public artifact CDN redirects may occur; no credentials or private data sent. Normal init/run/check is offline.
